h1: How to Choose a Playground Equipment Manufacturer in India

props.title: How to Choose a Playground Equipment Manufacturer in India
props.summaryText: A buyer's checklist for schools, builders and civic bodies: the nine questions worth asking any playground equipment manufacturer in India before you place an order.
props.author: ananya-kulkarni
props.imageAlt: Colourful castle-themed multi play station on a blue rubber surface at a housing society

takeaways.text: Find out whether the supplier makes the equipment or trades it: it decides how quickly they can change, repair and supply spares.
Ask for material specifications in writing: plastic grade, steel finish and fixings.
Check which safety standard the designs follow and what surface they recommend for each unit.
Compare quotes only on the same scope: models, surfacing, installation, transport and GST.
Call two or three clients with a similar project before you sign.

faq.q: What should I ask a playground equipment manufacturer before ordering?
faq.a: Ask whether they make the equipment themselves, what materials and coatings each part uses, which safety standards the designs follow, who installs it, and what the warranty covers in writing. Ask for two or three clients with a similar project that you can call.

faq.q: Which safety standards apply to playground equipment in India?
faq.a: Many manufacturers in India design to the European standards EN 1176 for equipment and EN 1177 for impact-absorbing surfacing. Ask the supplier which standard each unit follows and what surface they recommend for its fall height.

faq.q: Why do playground equipment quotes vary so much?
faq.a: Quotes often cover different scopes. One may include safety surfacing, transport, installation and GST while another leaves them out. Compare quotes only after listing the same items, models and material specifications side by side.
